optional_flags.--records: Original indices as comma list/inclusive ranges; default 0..127. Never converts to sorted spin/k positions.
optional_flags.--workers: Default 1; at most min(number of supplied CPUs,128). One explicitly pinned logical CPU for each active case.
optional_flags.--producer: Default sibling export_full_source_modes.py, implemented by parent.
optional_flags.--python: Executable PATH, defaults current interpreter. Invocation preserves virtualenv symlink path while binding actual executable bytes.

batch_cli.producer_interface: Exact contract001 flags, with --output pointing to a fresh nonexistent generation-container/case directory; producer creates its case directory.
batch_cli.durability: Exclusive JSON writes fsync data and parent directory. Intent precedes spawn. Raw stdout/stderr fsynced before immutable outcome receipt. Outcome reloaded from disk before consuming producer done/result. No generation is overwritten or deleted.
batch_cli.resume: Only successful durable subprocess exit plus binding-compatible intent and authenticated done.json result bytes/SHA/path can skip a whole sector. Bare results, absent exits, incompatible or failed generations remain preserved and cause a fresh generation. Multiple compatible committed generations for one record cause explicit failure, not silent selection.
batch_cli.cost: Linux wait4 supplies actual subprocess user/system CPU and peak RSS; elapsed times and actual accepted producer physical action counters are reported. Failed generation action counts remain explicitly unknown, not fabricated zero. Reuse is not charged as new execution.
batch_cli.exit_codes: 0=requested set complete; 1=incomplete/configuration/producer/readout failure; 130=handled SIGINT/SIGTERM interruption. Full-original128 coverage is a separate explicit summary flag.
batch_cli.resource_assumptions: Linux os.wait4, sched_getaffinity and taskset available; CPU list lies within inherited affinity. BLAS/OpenMP thread counts forced to1. Parent supplies actual resource/wall grants after authorized real pilot. No automatic retry, Native history continuation, resource discovery, or execution on import.

aggregation_cli.case_selection: Repeat --done CASE/done.json and/or --batch-summary RUN/summary.json. At least one committed case required. Summaries contribute only their explicit completed receipt list. Duplicate records, including overlaps between summaries, fail explicitly.
aggregation_cli.output: Complete raw unweighted sector covariance rows, original source authority, work and done/result bindings; weighted aggregate full 2x2 rows, all RR/RE/ER/EE blocks, block reconstructions, aggregate arithmetic defects and separately summed raw input defects. AB and BA remain distinct complex values.
aggregation_cli.normalization: Sum actual case quadrature_weight times each unweighted C exactly once. Original weight must be1/64. Explicit128 spin/internal-k sectors, no extra spin factor2, no final spatial1/N, no partial renormalization, no PSD repair or symmetrization.
aggregation_cli.coverage: Exact original indices0..127 and matching both-spin64 meshes required for complete status. Partial output lists every missing original record and is labelled partial. Duplicate/incompatible data yields status invalid, not an accepted numerical sum.
aggregation_cli.output_publication: Exclusive fsynced JSON; parent output directory must already exist. Existing aggregate files never overwritten.

producer_result_integration_requirements: done.json has result={path,bytes,sha256}, binding sibling result.json after full fsync.
result matches contract schema, complete status, unweighted quadrature, exact integer mode_indices[0,1], and mode_archive binding.
